parameters.excerpt: Different privilege modes may have different pointer masking settings active simultaneously and the hardware will automatically apply the pointer masking settings of the currently active privilege mode.
parameters.reasoning: The implementation can choose to have different pointer masking settings for different privilege modes, which is a design-time decision.
